detail: J B Ecotex Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to ₹ 400 croreand an offer for sale of up to 12,950,000 equity shares by certain promoter selling shareholders. Trilegal is advising J B Ecotex and the promoter selling shareholders on the IPO. The transaction is being led by Richa Choudhary (Partner) and Murtaza Zoomkawala (Partner), with support from Rainika Malhotra (Senior Associate), Associates Rajat Chauksey, Pallavi Vuppu and Nandini Ravishankar.
